answer: The document suggests that focusing only on algorithmic bias and fairness in Responsible AI (RAI) research often assumes these issues are solely due to poor implementation of a system, which distracts from validating the basic functionality of the systems and the underlying factors that lead to injustices. It indicates that this narrow focus may overlook important contextual factors that determine the outcomes of AI systems during their implementation, deployment, and use. Additionally, it raises concerns that RAI research may inadvertently take for granted that AI systems work or are inevitable, failing to critically reflect on whether techno-solutions are justifiable.
